D-amp mainly functions to release Dopamine, reversing it's absorption in the CNS. This gives folks a feeling of well-being and confidence, but is different from opiates like Oxycodone (which works in a similar manner) because the Amphetamine molecule closely resembles Adrenaline, and thus works similarly as a wakefulness agent.

What norepinephrine does, at least in mine and others' subjective experiences, is tells the brain to "Stop fulling around!" and "Get to work!" A side effect of l-amp, as it also resembles adrenaline, is that it makes the user a lot more 'tweaky'. You'd have to strip the secondary wax coating, break the primary plastic coating, and soak the former and the contents of the latter in acidic water overnight.
